description:
How your posts performed. post_metrics: per-network metrics of published posts (views, likes, comments, average view duration, published date), filterable by persona, network, account and window. last_day: the views and engagement each video gained in the last 24 hours (the difference between two daily readings, not a lifetime total), with totals, filterable by persona, network and account; a video published less than 24 hours ago counts everything since publishing, a video with no reading from about a day earlier lands in skipped.noBaseline, and a counter that went backwards counts as 0 (counterResets). retention_curve: the YouTube audience retention curve of one post. share_link_create: a public read-only link (no login) to the metrics summary of the first 7 days and this week's posts, optionally limited to one persona and an expiry; the url is returned once and only its hash is stored. share_link_list: your links with their scope, expiry, revocation and last view, never the url. share_link_revoke: stops a link at once.
Actions and their required fields: post_metrics (window); last_day (no required fields); retention_curve (account, video); share_link_create (no required fields); share_link_list (no required fields); share_link_revoke (id).

account.description: Optional publishing account id filter (the account ids from accounts (action: list)).

action.description: What to do: post_metrics | last_day | retention_curve | share_link_create | share_link_list | share_link_revoke. The description lists the fields each action needs.

angle.description: Optional script angle filter (exact match), or ^@none for posts with no angle.

expiresInDays.description: Optional lifetime of the link in days (1-365). Without it the link never expires.

id.description: The share link id (id from insights (action: share_link_list)).

persona.description: Optional persona id filter (uuid from personas (action: list)), or ^@none for posts with no persona.

video.description: The YouTube video id: externalId from a youtube insights (action: post_metrics) row.

window.description: Snapshot window: 24h (first day after publishing), 7d (first week) or 28d (four weeks; YouTube Analytics values are final).

name: insights
